figures.finding: No enforceable agreement sets a New Zealand screenwriter's pay: the NZ Writers Guild publishes recommended minimums only, and bargaining under the Screen Industry Workers Act 2022 has not begun because no producers' body has registered.

value.law: Screen Industry Workers Act 2022, in force 2022-12-30
value.status: NZWG registered; SPADA not registered as engager; MoU presented 2026-05-14

sources.said: These rates are not currently enforceable. … NZWG is looking forward to commencing collective contract negotiations and creating enforceable minimum rates for screenwriters!

While several worker groups like NZWG have registered, no producer groups, (such as SPADA), have officially registered to bargain. … SPADA was officially presented with a Memorandum of Understanding 14 May 2026 … The Act came into force on 30 December 2022.
In the early 2000s, NZWG successfully negotiated the Model Contract with the Screen Production and Development Association (SPADA).

figures.finding: The NZ Film Commission funds feature development, including writers' fees, up to NZ$140,000 a project in tranches of up to NZ$35,000; the Writers Guild's Seed grants pay NZ$12,500 for a first draft (NZ$3,000 of it for script consultation), Seed Advanced NZ$15,500.

seed_advanced.for: writers with over 90 minutes of scripted broadcast credits

figures.applies: NZ citizens or permanent residents; NZFC guidelines as at September 2026.

sources.said: scriptwriting fees … Each film project can access a maximum of $140,000 cumulative Funding (Cumulative Funding Cap). When applying for a tranche of Funding, you can apply for up to $35,000 each time.

NZWG Seed Grants offer 4 grants of $12,500 (+ GST if applicable) per round for the development of a first draft of a feature film script. … NZWG Seed Advanced Grants offer 2 grants of $15,500 (+ GST if applicable) per round

figures.finding: The NZ Writers Guild is a registered trade union; full membership costs NZ$200 to NZ$425 a year by credits and earnings, plus a NZ$60 joining fee.

thresholds.A_plus: over 50 min credits and/or over $50,000 earnings

sources.said: There is a joining Fee of $60 that is paid only once provided continuous membership is then maintained. Full A+ Annual Fee $ 425 … More than 50 mins of screenwriting credits and/or earnings from screenwriting in previous year over $50,000 … Full A Annual Fee $ 300 … Full C Annual Fee $ 200

figures.finding: The NZ Writers Guild's November 2021 guide recommends NZ$65,000-120,000 for an original feature screenplay (NZ$40,000-120,000 for a writer for hire), staged as NZ$15,000 for a treatment, NZ$25,000 for a first draft, NZ$15,000 and NZ$10,000 for the second and third drafts and NZ$3,000-5,000 for a polish, or 3-6% of the budget; a one-hour TV episode NZ$15,000-30,000 and a half hour NZ$10,000-20,000, plus GST; these rates are not enforceable.
figures.applies: New Zealand-funded production; recommended ranges as published in November 2021 (the current guide is members-only); rates exclude GST.

Posted Tuesday 09 Nov 2021 … The NZWG Rates Guide has been researched over three years and updated based on current market rates and funding allocations for work on local productions.

figures.finding: The same 2021 guide recommends option fees of NZ$500-5,000 a year for one to two years on a feature (an original screenplay or an underlying work) and NZ$2,000-5,000 a year on a TV series idea, not to be deducted from the purchase or script fee, with any renewal paid and time-limited.
figures.applies: New Zealand; recommended, not enforceable; November 2021 edition.

sources.said: The option fee should not be offset against (i.e., deducted from) the purchase or script fee. … Any renewals of the option should also be paid and have an end date. … Recommended Range $500 to $5,000 per year … Duration 1-2 years … Recommended Range $2000 to $5,000 per year
